)

Synchronous
Reentrancy

controller
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
CanIf_TTMasterState
Address to store return value: Master state
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Function successful
E_NOT_OK: Development error occurred
Description
Gets the master state. The master state includes the sync mode (sync_off, synchronizing, in_
gap, in_schedule) the master-slave mode (master_off, slave, backup_master, current_master)
and the current value for ref trigger offset.
